# Templates — The Shape A Document Should Take

The canonical skeletons for per-package documentation: what sections a kit
interface and a kit specification carry, in what order. A template is copied,
not cited — if a document links to one instead of following it, the template has
failed.

Changing a template does not retroactively change the documents written from it.
That is deliberate: a template is a starting point, and rewriting shipped
documents to match a new skeleton is a migration, with everything that implies.

This directory publishes.
